facts.fact: A data-policy training session held on 24 September 2025 in Antananarivo, part of a multi-day workshop run by Team Europe's Data Governance in Africa Action, brought together over 50 delegates from SADC, SATA, SAPOA and CRASA to discuss joint approaches to regional cooperation, data-sharing agreements and harmonised cross-border regulation.

facts.fact: In the week of 27 July 2020 the African Union's first online school on Internet governance, run with PRIDA to support countries such as Madagascar, was given to the 17-member organising committee of Madagascar's national Internet Governance Forum; the AU Commission/PRIDA also spoke at the forum's opening and closing on 27-28 August 2020.

facts.fact: Smart Africa names Madagascar among the 19 signatories of the SATA Declaration on digital trust and cross-border interoperability.

facts.fact: L'Express de Madagascar reports Madagascar formally signed its accession to the Smart Africa Trust Alliance (SATA), an AfCFTA-linked initiative, after a Smart Africa steering committee meeting at MWC Barcelona, represented by its digital minister.
